findings.issue: Book titles are truncated aggressively with ellipses (e.g., 'A Light in the ...', 'Sapiens: A Brief History ...'), hiding essential bibliographic information.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot identify the full titles of the books directly from the browsing grid, forcing them to click on individual items or guess, which increases cognitive friction.
findings.recommendation: A static screenshot does not provide enough visible evidence to make a concrete recommendation about this interaction state.

findings.issue: The sidebar contains a long, flat list of over 50 book categories with small font size, tight line spacing, and no logical grouping or search mechanism.
findings.user_impact: Users suffer from decision paralysis and must scroll through a tedious list to find specific genres, leading to an inefficient browsing experience.
findings.recommendation: Group categories into logical parent headers (e.g., Fiction, Non-Fiction, Academic) or add a simple, real-time text filter input at the top of the sidebar list.

findings.issue: The star rating indicators utilize very low-contrast colors, with pale yellow representing filled stars and light gray representing empty stars against a white background.
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users or individuals viewing the site on low-brightness displays will struggle to differentiate between the ratings, making the visual data inaccessible.
findings.recommendation: Increase the contrast of the active stars using a darker yellow or amber color (#D97706 or similar) and ensure the inactive stars have a distinct, darker gray outline.
